tagline: Reviews agi-memory commands that rewrite, delete, remotely sync, or bulk-seed the memory vault; reads stay unreviewed.
summary: Reviews agi-memory commands that rewrite the canonical memory vault, permanently delete a memory across every synced machine, attach a remote that will receive the whole store, bulk-seed it from git history, or change the invariants injected into later sessions. Reads such as recall, log, inspect, blocks and sync status stay unreviewed.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the reviewed operations and the surrounding Guard policy.
A maintainer profile is not a security certification or an official upstream endorsement.
